headlines.description: The Minnesota Vikings survived injuries to Adrian Peterson and Christian Ponder on back-to-back plays Saturday to end a six-game losing streak, beating the Washington Redskins 33-26.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings lose Peterson, Ponder, hold off Redskins
